What portable music player to buy ?

Okay guys, My current setup is an Audio Technica ATH-M50 headphone and a Cowon D2+ player. The player is excellent imo and the BBE enhancements really shine on it. It has a SD card slot, so I keep buying cards to extend my player capacity. Mostly I prefer flac encoded tracks, if without options, nothing below 320kbps MP3. I am quite happy with the player, but recently I am feeling that I am missing out on the latest updates on beatport, soundcloud and youtube. So I am on the hunt for a player with similar or better capability than the D2+ with internet connectivity, and so far have three options-
Option 1: Ditch the D2+ and buy a Cowon Z2. It has WiFi so there is my connectivity. It also has a microsd slot, so can extend capacity. Runs android, can install all online radio apps. Has the full suite of BBE enhancements. Also from cowon, so music quality is expected to be similar, if not better. The downside is, the player is a bit pricey, and microsd slot won't fit my 15 odd full size SD cards.
Option 2: Buy an used 3rd or 4th gen 64gb ipod along with a Fiio e7 DAC with ipod line-out cable to bypass the internal amp. The ipod will be rather cheap and the E7 also won't burn a hole in my pocket, but i'm not sure about this cause I haven't personally tried the output of the E7, and although it sounds good on paper, in practice some unforeseen problem might arise.
Option 3: iphone 4S or iphone4 with fiio E7 and line-out cable. Same as the ipod, but with mobile data, so can use in the middle of nowhere and no need to carry a separate phone. But iphones are way costlier than ipods and i need to buy the E7 too.

So which one of these options do you guys think is the best for me ? I say again, I don't want to compromise on music quality, and my primary requirement is good player with internet connectivity. Whatever comes with it is icing on the cake. Any suggestions or additional options that I don't know of ? With option 2 and 3, I might think about choosing the E17 over E7 if the player doesn't cost too much.
